title: Blind Charlie's tonk bands and piano players
summary: Barnes says Charlie played in small tonk groups, with the Martins and Coochie as pianists and guitarists.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I still want to know more about Blind Charlie because I just don't know who he played with or anything. I don't know the names of the bands.
Well Charlie was no more than a tonk band. He just played with these little. Little four piece band or three piece band. Team piano drums. Or maybe piano drum and trumpet.
Well who were some of the piano players he played with?
Who would those guys be? Oh man, I can't call his name. He was Martin. How'd he call him? One of the Martins. I can't call him Martin.

Was he a brother of Henry Martin? Yeah, yeah. He was Henry Martin's brother. Brother, yeah. Well then let's see, there was Coochie was a guitar player. Coochie. Coochie. Coochie was a guitar player and a piano player.
That's what I mean, Coochie. Well all them fellas, they didn't play much in bands, you know what I mean? Six piece, seven piece bands. They were in those cabalets and trucks in different places.
And Peele would be playing in those kind of places too? Zell? Yeah.
Yeah, they played in those places too.
